summary.headline: composed_rate is the share of installations whose exfiltration chain exists only because of how packages combine. Per-package review cannot see those, which is the entire argument for measuring composition.
summary.lower_bound_note: Capabilities are derived statically and are a lower bound, so the true closure rate is at least this high and cannot be lower.
